theorem latticeG_eq_LFunction_mul {q : ℕ} [NeZero q] (hq : 0 < q) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ q)

declarations.name: positive_block_periodization
declarations.source_statement:
theorem positive_block_periodization (c q : ℕ) [NeZero c] [NeZero q]
    (hq : 0 < q) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ q) (s : ℂ) (hs : 1 < s.re)
    (y : ℝ) (hy : 0 < y) (x : ℝ) :
    block hq χ c s y hy x = χ (c : ZMod q) * rowScale c q s *
      ∑ p : ZMod q × ZMod c, χ p.1 * periodizedComplexPowerSeed y s (x + shift c q p)

declarations.name: gauss_ne_zero
declarations.source_statement:
theorem gauss_ne_zero {q : ℕ} [NeZero q] {χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ q}
    (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) : gauss χ ≠ 0

declarations.name: positive_blockFourier
declarations.source_statement:
theorem positive_blockFourier (c q : ℕ) [NeZero c] [NeZero q] (hq : 0 < q)
    (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ q) (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) (s : ℂ) (hs : 1 < s.re)
    (y : ℝ) (hy : 0 < y) (n : ℤ) :
    blockFourier hq χ c s y hy n =
      if (c : ℤ) ∣ n then χ (c : ZMod q) * rowScale c q s *
        ((c : ℂ)*star (χ ((n/(c : ℤ) : ℤ) : ZMod q))*gauss χ) * actualPowerFourier y n s
      else 0

declarations.name: latticeFourier_all_c
declarations.source_statement:
theorem latticeFourier_all_c {q : ℕ} (hq : 0 < q) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ q)
    (s : ℂ) (hs : 1 < s.re) (y : ℝ) (hy : 0 < y) (n : ℤ) :
    Summable (fun c : ℤ => blockFourier hq χ c s y hy n) ∧
    latticeFourier hq χ s y hy n =
      (1/2 : ℂ) * ∑' c : ℤ, blockFourier hq χ c s y hy n

declarations.source_statement:
theorem latticeFourier_nat_c {q : ℕ} (hq : 0 < q) (h1 : q ≠ 1)

    (y : ℝ) (hy : 0 < y) (n : ℤ) :

declarations.name: latticeFourier_divisor
declarations.source_statement:
theorem latticeFourier_divisor {q : ℕ} [NeZero q] (hq : 0 < q) (h1 : q ≠ 1)
    (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ q) (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) (s : ℂ) (hs : 1 < s.re)

declarations.source_statement:

declarations.name: critical_oldform
declarations.source_statement:
theorem critical_oldform {q : ℕ} [NeZero q] (hq : 0 < q) (h1 : q ≠ 1)
    (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ q) (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) (N : ℕ) (d : ℕ+)
    (hlevel : q^2*(d : ℕ) ∣ N) (g : SL(2,ℤ)) (hg : g ∈ CongruenceSubgroup.Gamma0 N)
    (t : ℝ) (z : ℍ) :
    primitiveFamily χ (1/2 + Complex.I*t) (degeneracyDiagonal d d.pos • (g • z)) =
      primitiveFamily χ (1/2 + Complex.I*t) (degeneracyDiagonal d d.pos • z) ∧
    DifferentiableAt ℂ (fun s => primitiveFamily χ s (degeneracyDiagonal d d.pos • z))
      (1/2 + Complex.I*t)

declarations.source_statement:
theorem oldform_invariant {q : ℕ} [NeZero q] (hq : 0 < q) (h1 : q ≠ 1)

    (hlevel : q^2*(d : ℕ) ∣ N) (s : ℂ) (g : SL(2,ℤ))
    (hg : g ∈ CongruenceSubgroup.Gamma0 N) (z : ℍ) :

declarations.name: infinity_fourier
declarations.source_statement:
theorem infinity_fourier {q : ℕ} [NeZero q] (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ q)
    (d : ℕ+) (s : ℂ) (y : ℝ) (hy : 0 < y) (n : ℤ) (hn : n ≠ 0) :
    (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..1, fourierPhase n x * oldform χ d s (horizontalPoint y hy x)) =
      (Real.sqrt y : ℂ) * infinityK χ d n s * complexOrderK (s-1/2) (2*Real.pi*|(n : ℝ)|*y)

declarations.name: oldform_fricke
declarations.source_statement:
theorem oldform_fricke {q : ℕ} [NeZero q] (hq : 0 < q) (h1 : q ≠ 1)
    (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ q) (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N)
    (d : ℕ+) (hlevel : q^2*(d : ℕ) ∣ N) (s : ℂ) (z : ℍ) :
    oldform χ d s (frickeSL N hN • z) =
      χ (-1 : ZMod q)*oldform χ (complement N q hN hq d hlevel) s z

declarations.name: original_cuspOne_fourier
declarations.source_statement:
theorem original_cuspOne_fourier {q : ℕ} [NeZero q] (hq : 0 < q) (h1 : q ≠ 1)
    (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ q) (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N)
    (d : ℕ+) (hlevel : q^2*(d : ℕ) ∣ N) (s : ℂ) (y : ℝ) (hy : 0 < y)
    (n : ℤ) (hn : n ≠ 0) :
    fourierCoeff (sigmaOneSection N hN (oldform χ d s)
      (oldform_invariant hq h1 χ hχ N d hlevel s) y hy) n =
      Complex.exp (2*Real.pi*I*(n : ℂ)/(N : ℂ)) * χ (-1 : ZMod q) *
      ((Real.sqrt y : ℂ)*infinityK χ (complement N q hN hq d hlevel) n s *
        complexOrderK (s-1/2) (2*Real.pi*|(n : ℝ)|*y))

declarations.name: physical_infinity_whittaker
declarations.source_statement:
theorem physical_infinity_whittaker {q : ℕ} [NeZero q] (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ q)
    (d : ℕ+) (s : ℂ) (y : ℝ) (hy : 0 < y) (n : ℤ) (hn : n ≠ 0) :
    (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..1, fourierPhase n x * oldform χ d s (horizontalPoint y hy x)) =
      ((infinityK χ d n s/2) / (Real.sqrt |(n : ℝ)| : ℂ)) *
        (2*(Real.sqrt (|(n : ℝ)|*y) : ℂ)) * complexOrderK (s-1/2) (2*Real.pi*|(n : ℝ)|*y)

declarations.name: physical_whittaker
declarations.source_statement:
theorem physical_whittaker {q : ℕ} [NeZero q] (hq : 0 < q) (h1 : q ≠ 1)
    (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ q) (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N)
    (d : ℕ+) (hlevel : q^2*(d : ℕ) ∣ N) (s : ℂ) (y : ℝ) (hy : 0 < y)
    (n : ℤ) (hn : n ≠ 0) :
    fourierCoeff (sigmaOneSection N hN (oldform χ d s)
      (oldform_invariant hq h1 χ hχ N d hlevel s) y hy) n =
      (cuspOneR χ N (complement N q hN hq d hlevel) n s / (Real.sqrt |(n : ℝ)| : ℂ)) *
        (2*(Real.sqrt (|(n : ℝ)|*y) : ℂ)) * complexOrderK (s-1/2) (2*Real.pi*|(n : ℝ)|*y)

declarations.name: original_index_character_whittaker
declarations.source_statement:
theorem original_index_character_whittaker
    (D : OriginalData) (k : BlockKey) (z : Row D k) (ha : D.block.atom.residue ≠ 0)
    (negativeM : Bool) {n : ℕ} (hn : n ∈ nCarrier D k z.val) {q : ℕ} [NeZero q]
    (hq : 0 < q) (h1 : q ≠ 1) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ q) (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive)
    (d : ℕ+) (hlevel : q^2*(d : ℕ) ∣ z.val) (s : ℂ) (y : ℝ) (hy : 0 < y) :
    let j := traceIndex D k negativeM z.val n
    let hN := (levelCarrier_licensed D k z.property).1
    fourierCoeff (sigmaOneSection z.val hN (oldform χ d s)
      (oldform_invariant hq h1 χ hχ z.val d hlevel s) y hy) j =
      (cuspOneR χ z.val (complement z.val q hN hq d hlevel) j s / (Real.sqrt |(j : ℝ)| : ℂ)) *
        (2*(Real.sqrt (|(j : ℝ)|*y) : ℂ)) * complexOrderK (s-1/2) (2*Real.pi*|(j : ℝ)|*y)

declarations.name: actual_character_row_removal
declarations.source_statement:
theorem actual_character_row_removal
    (D : OriginalData) (r : ZMod (prefixPeriod D.key)) (k : BlockKey) (z : Row D k)
    (upper negativeM : Bool) (ell : D4 → ℤ) {q : ℕ} [NeZero q]
    (hq : 0 < q) (_h1 : q ≠ 1) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ q) (_hχ : χ.IsPrimitive)
    (d : ℕ+) (hlevel : q^2*(d : ℕ) ∣ z.val) (s : ℂ) :
    let e := complement z.val q (levelCarrier_licensed D k z.property).1 hq d hlevel
    (∑ n ∈ nCarrier D k z.val, traceBeta D r k upper negativeM ell z.val n *
      cuspOneR χ z.val e (traceIndex D k negativeM z.val n) s) =
      pairAmplitude χ χ (D.block.atom.residue.natAbs*k.1) s *
      ∑ n ∈ nCarrier D k z.val, (modulatedBeta D r k upper ell z.val n *
        sourceCuspPhase z.val (-(principalTraceSign D k negativeM*(n : ℤ)))) *
        cuspOneR χ z.val e (principalTraceSign D k negativeM*(n : ℤ)) s

declarations.name: actual_character_row_squared
declarations.source_statement:
theorem actual_character_row_squared
    (D : OriginalData) (r : ZMod (prefixPeriod D.key)) (k : BlockKey) (z : Row D k)
    (upper negativeM : Bool) (ell : D4 → ℤ) {q : ℕ} [NeZero q]
    (hq : 0 < q) (h1 : q ≠ 1) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ q) (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive)
    (d : ℕ+) (hlevel : q^2*(d : ℕ) ∣ z.val) (t : ℝ) :
    let s : ℂ := 1/2 + (t : ℂ)*I
    let e := complement z.val q (levelCarrier_licensed D k z.property).1 hq d hlevel
    ‖∑ n ∈ nCarrier D k z.val, traceBeta D r k upper negativeM ell z.val n *
      cuspOneR χ z.val e (traceIndex D k negativeM z.val n) s‖^2 ≤
      ((D.block.atom.residue.natAbs*k.1).divisors.card : ℝ)^2 *
      ‖∑ n ∈ nCarrier D k z.val, (modulatedBeta D r k upper ell z.val n *
        sourceCuspPhase z.val (-(principalTraceSign D k negativeM*(n : ℤ)))) *
        cuspOneR χ z.val e (principalTraceSign D k negativeM*(n : ℤ)) s‖^2
